structured_output.summary: KIP-1066 is implemented across config, protocol, broker and controller, and CordonedLogDirsIntegrationTest passes (9/9). The metadata and tools unit tests I added could not be run by the harness. Two are checked via scratch copies in :server, and the tools test was not run at all. `DescribeLogDirsResponse` and `BrokerHeartbeatRequest` use tagged fields on already-released versions, because the matching request/response JSON files are not in my file list. `BrokerRegistrationChangeRecord` gets a proper v3.

criteria_notes.note: CordonedLogDirsIntegrationTest.testInvalidCordonedLogDirsAreRejected: paths not in log.dirs, another broker's dir and the cluster-wide default are rejected. testCordonedLogDirectoriesAreNotUsedForNewPartitions: DELETE op uncordons, and '*' and multi-dir values work. The log.dirs check is in KafkaConfig.validateValues, plus the DynamicCordonedLogDirs reconfigurable.

CordonedLogDirsIntegrationTest.testCordoningRequiresMetadataVersion (4.2-IV1): dynamic set returns InvalidConfigurationException, static '*' has no effect, and removal is still allowed. The gating is in ConfigurationControlManager and LogManager.cordonedLogDirs. ReplicationControlManagerTest.testCordonedDirectoriesAreIgnoredBeforeMetadataVersion covers the controller ignoring heartbeat reports.

CordonedLogDirsIntegrationTest.testBrokerWithAllLogDirectoriesCordonedReceivesNoNewPartitions and testStaticallyCordonedBroker poll until the controller excludes the broker, so heartbeats carry the dirs after catch-up and dynamic changes apply without restart. ReplicationControlManagerTest.testHandleCordonedDirectoriesInHeartbeat covers null, unchanged, changed and cleared reports.

Integration test: INVALID_REPLICATION_FACTOR once a fully cordoned broker leaves too few brokers, and createTopics and createPartitions only place on the other brokers. ReplicationControlManagerTest.testCordonedBrokersAreNotUsedForNewReplicas and ClusterControlManagerTest.testCordonedDirectories cover the same at unit level.

Integration test: InvalidReplicaAssignmentException for createTopics and createPartitions with explicit assignments onto the cordoned broker. Unit test in ReplicationControlManagerTest covers the same.

Integration test: alterPartitionReassignments onto the cordoned broker gives IneligibleReplicaException. The unit test also checks that an existing replica on a cordoned broker may stay while a new uncordoned one is added.
CordonedLogDirsIntegrationTest.testAlterReplicaLogDirsToCordonedDirectory: InvalidReplicaAssignmentException from ReplicaManager.alterReplicaLogDirs, then the move succeeds after uncordoning.

CordonedLogDirsIntegrationTest.testBrokerDoesNotCreateReplicaInCordonedDirectory calls LogManager.getOrCreateLog with a cordoned target dir id and verifies the log lands in the uncordoned dir. It also checks the fallback when all dirs are cordoned.

CordonedLogDirsIntegrationTest.testDescribeLogDirsReportsCordonedState checks LogDirDescription.isCordoned(). LogDirsCommandTest.testLogDirsShowsCordonedState checks the isCordoned field in the tool's JSON output.
CordonedLogDirsIntegrationTest.testCordonedLogDirectoryMetrics checks LogDirectoryCordoned per dir and CordonedLogDirectoryCount (0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 0) against the Yammer registry.
CordonedLogDirsIntegrationTest runs against an embedded 3-broker, 2-disk KRaft cluster, cordoning and uncordoning through the Admin client and checking placement and errors. All 9 tests pass.
